title: Add SRD equipment filter and proficiency resolution audit
description:
Child of the equipment grouping audit epic.

After preserving equipment grouping metadata, add an audit/resolver check that proves generated starting-equipment filters and class proficiency groups are actually satisfiable from the generated catalog.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add a deterministic audit that enumerates candidates for every generated starting-equipment filter.
- The audit fails if a filter such as martial melee weapon, arcane focus, druidic focus, holy symbol, musical instrument, artisan tools, gaming set, or similar emits zero candidates.
- Add a deterministic audit or resolver check for class equipment proficiencies such as Simple weapons, martial weapons, light armor, medium armor, heavy armor, shields, and tool/instrument proficiency groups.
- The audit should report the candidate count and representative candidate keys for reviewability.
- Wire the check into the SRD audit bundle or existing playable-model gate so future regressions are visible.
close_reason: Added srdEquipmentResolutionAudit resolving every starting-equipment filter and class equipment proficiency phrase to concrete equipment candidates; wired into the audit bundle CLI and a fail-closed regression test
